title: Poisoned TEST_HOME_ENV_MUTEX cascades one test panic into dozens of unrelated failures
outcome: Observed by Codex during tm-7p9z.3 (2026-09-05): one test panicked (a stale fs::read assertion after a preferences-only save) while holding the shared test-only static TEST_HOME_ENV_MUTEX (src/tests/mod.rs); every later test that takes the guard with .lock().expect("test env mutex poisoned") then failed before its body ran - 26 cascading failures masking the single real defect. The same shape applies to the sibling TEST_KILL_CHILD_PROCESS_FAILURE_MUTEX. Desired: test-only guards recover a poisoned lock (lock().unwrap_or_else(PoisonError::into_inner)) because the protected state (process env / kill-failure injection) is reset by each holder and does not become invalid on panic; keep the guards serialized; one failing test must produce one failure. Acceptance: a test that panics while holding the guard leaves the next holder runnable (regression test using catch_unwind); the expect("... poisoned") sites are gone; full wrapper green.
